 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScBank_All_Balances

;All Banks - Balances Script
;-------------
;- This script runs from dialogue results.
;- T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank is set via local
;  script and is used to report relevant balances.
;- Add more elseif conditions for new banks as they are 
;  added by copying and editing existing conditions.
;-------------
;Last modified on 250413

short doMath
;vanilla global DaysPassed

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK BELOW
;--------------------------------

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 1 ) ;Briricca Bank
    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount > 0 )
        MessageBox ""[您的账户余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount
    endif

    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount > 0 )
        set doMath to ( DaysPassed - T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanDate )
        set doMath to ( 10 - doMath )
        MessageBox ""[您的未偿贷款余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount
        MessageBox ""[您有 %G 天时间偿还您的未偿贷款余额]"" doMath
    endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank
    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount > 0 )
        MessageBox ""[您的账户余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount
    endif

    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount > 0 )
        set doMath to ( DaysPassed - T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanDate )
        set doMath to ( 10 - doMath )
        MessageBox ""[您的未偿贷款余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount
        MessageBox ""[您有 %G 天时间偿还您的未偿贷款余额]"" doMath
    endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 4 ) ;Winterhold Compact Bank
    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount > 0 )
        MessageBox ""[您的账户余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount
    endif

    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount > 0 )
        set doMath to ( DaysPassed - T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanDate )
        set doMath to ( 10 - doMath )
        MessageBox ""[您的未偿贷款余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount
        MessageBox ""[您有 %G 天时间偿还您的未偿贷款余额]"" doMath
    endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 5 ) ;Masolaude Merchant
    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount > 0 )
        MessageBox ""[您的账户余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount
    endif

    if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount > 0 )
        set doMath to ( DaysPassed - T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanDate )
        set doMath to ( 10 - doMath )
        MessageBox ""[您的未偿贷款余额为 %G 金币]"" T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount
        MessageBox ""[您有 %G 天时间偿还您的未偿贷款余额]"" doMath

;All Banks - Deposit Script
;-------------
;- This script runs from dialogue results and gold

;Last modified on 250413

long goldHold
;Add more bank-specific globals as necessary

set goldHold to ( Player->GetItemCount gold_001 )

if ( goldHold < T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )
	MessageBox ""[您没有足够的金币存入该金额。]""
	set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
	StopScript T_ScBank_All_Deposit
	Return
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 10 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 50 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 50
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 100 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 500 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 500

	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
endif

	set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount + T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScBank_All_LoanPayment

;All Banks - Loan Payment Script
;-------------
;- This script runs from dialogue results.
;- T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount is set via same
;  results as this StartScript.
;- T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank is set via local
;  script on hidden bank-specific ring and is 
;  used to start bank loan script.
;- Add more if blocks for new banks when they 
;  are added by copying and editing existing 
;  conditions.
;-------------
;Last modified on 250413

short failState
short goldHold
short loanHold
;Add more bank-specific globals as necessary

set goldHold to ( Player->GetItemCount gold_001 )

if ( goldHold < T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )
	MessageBox ""[您没有足够的金币进行该笔还款。]""
	set failState to 1
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK BELOW
;--------------------------------

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 1 ) ;Briricca Bank
	set loanHold to T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank
	set loanHold to T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 4 ) ;Winterhold Compact Bank
	set loanHold to T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 5 ) ;Masolaude Merchant
	set loanHold to T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 6 ) ;Crown Reserve
	set loanHold to T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount
else
	MessageBox ""T_ScBank_All_LoanPayment: Global T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank check failed.""
	set failState to 1
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK ABOVE
;--------------------------------

if ( failState != 1 )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount > loanHold )
		MessageBox ""[您支付的金额不能超过您所欠的金额。]""
		set failState to 1
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount <= loanHold )
		set loanHold to ( loanHold - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )
	endif
endif
	
if ( failState )
	set failState to 0
	set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
	StopScript T_ScBank_All_LoanPayment
	Return
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 10 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 50 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 50
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 100 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 500 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 500
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 1000 )
	Player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK BELOW
;--------------------------------

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 1 ) ;Briricca Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to loanHold

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币。您的贷款余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币并还清了贷款。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount

		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScBank_Bri_LoanCheck != 0 )
			StopScript T_ScBank_Bri_LoanCheck
			Return
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount to loanHold

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币。您的贷款余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_LoanAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币并还清了贷款。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount

		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScBank_Hla_LoanCheck != 0 )
			StopScript T_ScBank_Hla_LoanCheck
			Return
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 4 ) ;Winterhold Compact Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount to loanHold

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币。您的贷款余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_LoanAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币并还清了贷款。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount

		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScBank_Cmp_LoanCheck != 0 )
			StopScript T_ScBank_Cmp_LoanCheck
			Return
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 5 ) ;Masolaude Merchant
	set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to loanHold

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币。您的贷款余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币并还清了贷款。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount

		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScBank_Mas_LoanCheck != 0 )
			StopScript T_ScBank_Mas_LoanCheck
			Return
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 6 ) ;Crown Reserve
	set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to loanHold

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币。您的贷款余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已存入 %G 金币并还清了贷款。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount

		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScBank_Cro_LoanCheck != 0 )
			StopScript T_ScBank_Cro_LoanCheck
			Return
		endif
	endif
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK ABOVE
;--------------------------------

set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
StopScript T_ScBank_All_LoanPayment
Return

end$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScBank_All_Withdraw

;All Banks - Withdrawal Script
;-------------
;- This script runs from dialogue results and
;  gold condition checks.
;- T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount is set via same
;  results as this StartScript.
;- T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank is set via local
;  script on hidden bank-specific ring.
;- Add more if blocks for new banks when they 
;  are added by copying and editing existing 
;  conditions.
;-------------
;Last modified on 250413

long accountHold
;Add more bank-specific globals as necessary

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK BELOW
;--------------------------------

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 1 ) ;Briricca Bank
	set accountHold to T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank
	set accountHold to T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 4 ) ;Winterhold Compact Bank
	set accountHold to T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 5 ) ;Masolaude Merchant
	set accountHold to T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 6 ) ;Crown Reserve
	set accountHold to T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount
else
	MessageBox ""T_ScBank_All_Withdraw: Global T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank check failed.""
	set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
	StopScript T_ScBank_All_Withdraw
	Return
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK ABOVE
;--------------------------------

set accountHold to ( accountHold - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

if ( accountHold < 0 )
	set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
	MessageBox ""[您没有足够的金币提取该金额。]""
	StopScript T_ScBank_All_Withdraw
	Return
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 10 )
	Player->AddItem gold_001 10
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 50 )
	Player->AddItem gold_001 50
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 100 )
	Player->AddItem gold_001 100
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 500 )
	Player->AddItem gold_001 500
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount == 1000 )
	Player->AddItem gold_001 1000
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK BELOW
;--------------------------------

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 1 ) ;Briricca Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币。您的账户余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币并关闭了您的银行账户。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 3 ) ;Hlaalu Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币。您的账户余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Hla_AcctAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币并关闭了您的银行账户。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 4 ) ;Winterhold Compact Bank
	set T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币。您的账户余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cmp_AcctAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币并关闭了您的银行账户。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 5 ) ;Masolaude Merchant
	set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币。您的账户余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币并关闭了您的银行账户。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount
	endif
endif

if ( T_Glob_Bank_All_CurrentBank == 6 ) ;Crown Reserve
	set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount > 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币。您的账户余额现在为：%G 金币。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount == 0 )
		MessageBox ""[您已提取 %G 金币并关闭了您的银行账户。]"" T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount
	endif
endif

;--------------------------------
;ADD NEW BANKS TO THE BLOCK ABOVE
;--------------------------------

set T_Glob_Bank_All_TempAmount to 0
StopScript T_ScBank_All_Withdraw
Return
	
end$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScBank_Bri_LoanFail

;Briricca Bank - Loan Failure Script
;-------------
;- Runs once after 7 days pass on loan.
;- If player has deposit account, then 
;  funds are removed to pay off loan.
;- If no account or not enough funds then
;  player receives bounty for remaining debt.
;-------------
;Last modified on 200804

float crimeHold
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanFail

;If 7 days have passed then tack on additional 10 percent of outstanding loan
set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount + ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount * 0.1 ) )

;If player has deposit account then reduce the loan amount by those funds
if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount > 0 )

	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount < T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，布里里卡银行已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount == T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount to 0
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，布里里卡银行已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除，该账户现已关闭。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount > T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您拖欠布里里卡银行的贷款还款。您的存款账户已被关闭，并且您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
	endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Bri_AcctAmount <= 0 )
	MessageBox ""您拖欠布里里卡银行的贷款还款。您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
endif

;Increase player bounty by remaining outstanding loan amount
set crimeHold to ( GetPCCrimeLevel + T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount )

if ( crimeHold > 0 )
	
	if ( crimeHold > 5000 ) ;Make sure that player is not given a death warrant
		set crimeHold to 4500
	endif
	
	SetPCCrimeLevel crimeHold
endif

set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanAmount to 0
set T_Glob_Bank_Bri_LoanFail to 1
StopScript T_ScBank_Bri_LoanFail
Return

end$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScBank_Cro_LoanFail

;Crown Reserve - Loan Failure Script
;-------------
;- Runs once after 7 days pass on loan.
;- If player has deposit account, then
; funds are removed to pay off loan.
;- If no account or not enough funds then
; player receives bounty for remaining debt.
;-------------
;Last modified on 250413

float crimeHold
;global T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount
;global T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount
;global T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanFail

;If 7 days have passed then tack on additional 10 percent of outstanding loan
set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount + ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount * 0.1 ) )

;If player has deposit account then reduce the loan amount by those funds
if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount < T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，皇家储备已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount == T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount to 0
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，皇家储备已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除，该账户现已关闭。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount > T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您拖欠皇家储备的贷款还款。您的存款账户已被关闭，并且您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
	endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Cro_AcctAmount <= 0 )
	MessageBox ""您拖欠皇家储备的贷款还款。您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
endif

;Increase player bounty by remaining outstanding loan amount
set crimeHold to ( GetPCCrimeLevel + T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount )

if ( crimeHold > 0 )
	if ( crimeHold > 5000 ) ;Make sure that player is not given a death warrant
		set crimeHold to 4500
	endif

	SetPCCrimeLevel crimeHold
endif

set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanAmount to 0
set T_Glob_Bank_Cro_LoanFail to 1
StopScript T_ScBank_Cro_LoanFail

end$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScBank_Mas_LoanFail

;Masolaude Merchant - Loan Failure Script
;-------------
;- Runs once after 7 days pass on loan.
;- If player has deposit account, then
; funds are removed to pay off loan.
;- If no account or not enough funds then
; player receives bounty for remaining debt.
;-------------
;Last modified on 250413

float crimeHold
;global T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount
;global T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount
;global T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanFail

;If 7 days have passed then tack on additional 10 percent of outstanding loan
set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount + ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount * 0.1 ) )

;If player has deposit account then reduce the loan amount by those funds
if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount < T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，马索劳德商业银行已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount == T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount to 0
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您的付款已逾期，马索劳德商业银行已要求收回贷款。您的债务已从您的存款账户中扣除，该账户现已关闭。""
	elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount > T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount - T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount )
		set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount to 0
		MessageBox ""您拖欠马索劳德商业银行的贷款还款。您的存款账户已被关闭，并且您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
	endif
elseif ( T_Glob_Bank_Mas_AcctAmount <= 0 )
	MessageBox ""您拖欠马索劳德商业银行的贷款还款。您因剩余债务被悬赏通缉。""
endif

;Increase player bounty by remaining outstanding loan amount
set crimeHold to ( GetPCCrimeLevel + T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount )

if ( crimeHold > 0 )
	if ( crimeHold > 5000 ) ;Make sure that player is not given a death warrant
		set crimeHold to 4500
	endif

	SetPCCrimeLevel crimeHold
endif

set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanAmount to 0
set T_Glob_Bank_Mas_LoanFail to 1
StopScript T_ScBank_Mas_LoanFail

end$00"
-SCPT

short PCSkipEquip
short pickedup

	set pickedup to 0
	if ( player->GetSpell ""T_De_Res_Generosity"" == 0 ) ;if you haven't already got the spell
		if ( player->GetIntelligence >= 70 )
			Player->AddSpell ""T_De_Res_Generosity""
			MessageBox ""您已从这卷卷轴中学会了“慷慨”法术。""
			PlaySound ""skillraise""
		elseif ( player->GetIntelligence >= 60 )
			MessageBox ""这卷卷轴中记载了可学习的法术，但您无法解读它。""
		endif
	endif
endif

   set pickedup to 1
   return
endif

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
   return

   Activate
   set pickedup to 1

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScCrea_ArmorCenturionEquip
; Since we can't have ""smart"" leveled lists, such as ""one sword or one crossbow and twenty bolts"",
; this script manages the centurion's equipment based on his leveled list result. That way, a single
; creature is needed to provide for a variety of random armor centurion warriors, with crossbow and
; bolts, darts, one-handed weapon and shield, or two-handed weapons without shield.

short control		; determines how the script will work

if ( ondeath == 1 )
	set control to 5 ; avoids the ""Golena Sadri Bug""...
endif

if ( control >= 5 )
	return

elseif ( control == 4 ) ; dwemer bot fights with darts
	if ( getitemcount ""T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01"" < 10 )
		additem ""T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01"" 10
	endif

elseif ( control == 3 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with crossbow
	if ( getitemcount ""T_Dwe_Regular_Bolt_01"" < 10 )
		additem ""T_Dwe_Regular_Bolt_01"" 10
	endif

elseif ( control == 2 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with 2H weapon
	set control to 5

elseif ( control == 1 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with 1H weapon
	set control to ( Player->GetLevel + 50 )
	if ( control > Random100 )
		additem ""T_Dwe_Regular_ShieldTower_01"" 1
		equip ""T_Dwe_Regular_ShieldTower_01""
	else
		additem ""dwemer_shield"" 1
		equip ""dwemer_shield""
	endif
	set control to 5

elseif ( control == 0 )
; Stupid ""GetWeaponType"" function being, well, not functional, I have no choice but to use that ugly
; prescriptive code rather than the elegant, simple descriptive code that should have theoretically
; been possible if Bethesda didn't hate modders. Grr. I'm bitter.
; Anyway, this script is simply impossible to do without using a fucking list of all the possible
; weapons the centurion can have, which means the script has to be updated if the leveled list is.

	if ( GetItemCount ""dwarven battle axe"" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount ""dwarven claymore"" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount ""dwarven halberd"" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount ""dwarven mace"" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount ""dwarven shortsword"" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount ""dwarven spear"" > 0 )
		set control to 2

1C 20 58 FD 10 20 6F 14 54 5F 49 6E 67 43 72 65 61 5F 45 79 65 73 74 61 72 5F 30 31 00 DA 10 05 01 73 03 00 02 20 30 09 01 01 01]
 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScCrea_EyestarHarvest

; An attempt to make a script that lets one harvest eyestars for parts. Eyestars were first meant to be creatures, but since 
; they lack the required animations, this is the way to still make them dangerous and potentially useful, i.e., elements of
; gameplay rather than mere eyestarcandy.


short button		; for the messagebox stuff
short chance	; for random stuff
short state		; generic control var stuff


if ( OnActivate )
	set chance to ( Player->GetLuck )						; computes the player's chance at harvesting harmlessly
	set chance to ( chance + Player->GetAlchemy )		; by making the sum of his luck, his knowledge of harvesting
	set chance to ( chance + Player->GetAgility )		; ingredients, and his manual dexterity.
	set chance to ( chance / 4 )								; But let's not get the result too high.
	MessageBox ""您想要尝试收割这颗眼之星的眼球吗？"" ""是"" ""否""
	set state to 1
endif

if ( state == 0 )			; no need to process all the rest 99.97% of the time.
	return
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button == -1 )
		return
	elseif ( button == 0 )
		if ( chance > random100 )			; rewards high scores, they're more likely to be higher than random100.
			set state to 5						; directly moves on to last stage.
			set button to 30					; uses var button to ""store"" success
			return
		else
			set chance to ( chance * 1.2 )	; let's address the case where full success was not missed by much.
			if ( chance > random100 )
				set state to 4
				set button to 20
				return
			else
				set chance to ( chance * 1.2 )
				if ( chance > random100 )
					set state to 3
					set button to 10
					return
				else
					set state to 2
					set button to -10
					return
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( button == 1 )						; for those who had a pang of conscience and let the poor thingie alone.
		set state to 0
	endif
endif

if ( state == 2 )									; only those who miserably failed to harvest will get this.
	Player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
		if ( Random100 >= 85 )
			Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_WitchesPox""
		endif
	endif
	set state to 3								; moves on to next stage
endif

if ( state == 3 )									; only those who failed to harvest will get this.
	player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
		if ( random100 >= 75 )
			Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_ChronDiasis""
		endif
	endif
	set state to 4								; moves on to next stage
endif

if ( state == 4 )									; you get infected; disease severity depends on how bad you were.
	player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( chance < 36 )
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( random100 >= 75 )
				Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_CalironsCurse""
				Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_Wizardfever""
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( chance < 48 )
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( random100 >= 65 )
				Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_CalironsCurse""
			endif
		endif
	else
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( Random100 >= 65 )
				Player->AddSpell ""T_Dis_Wizardfever""
			endif
		endif
	endif
	set state to 5
endif

if ( state == 5 )													; last stage
	if ( button >= 20 )
		Player->AddItem ""T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01"" 1
		RemoveItem ""T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01"" 1
		MessageBox ""您成功提取了星之眼。""
	elseif ( button >= random 30 )
		Player->AddItem ""T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01"" 1
		RemoveItem ""T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01"" 1
		MessageBox ""您设法提取了星之眼。""
	else
		MessageBox ""您的尝试失败了，眼之星攻击了您。""
	endif
	set state to -10
	disable													; then disappear
	return
endif


if ( GetItemCount ""T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01"" )					; once the container respawns its eye,
	enable														; makes it reappear, too. Respawn, really.
	set state to 0												; and goes back to normal.
endif

End
$00"
-SCPT

; Gives kagouti a scale between 0.85 and 1.15.
; Inspired by the scripts used by PirateLord for the Creatures mod.

float RandNum
float NewScale

if ( DoOnce == 1 )
	return
endif

set RandNum to ( RandNum - 150 )
set NewScale to ( 1 + ( RandNum / 1000 ) )
setScale NewScale

set DoOnce to 1

end

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScCrea_MummyRise_02

;this is a script which makes a mummy seem like it's dead
;it'll become undead when the player is near

short dormant
float timer

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( dormant == 0 )	;the mummy is knocked out -- making it sit down and wait
	SetFatigue 0
	SetFight 0
	set dormant to 1
endif

if ( OnDeath == 1 )
	set dormant to 3
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	if ( dormant == 3 )
		Activate
	endif
endif

if ( dormant == 1 )
	if ( OnActivate == 1 )
		SetFatigue 1000
		SetFight 100
		startcombat, player
		set dormant to 2
	endif
endif

if ( dormant == 1 )
	if ( GetDistance, player <= 512 )
		if ( timer < 8 )
			set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
		elseif ( timer >= 8 )
			SetFatigue 1000
			SetFight 100
			startcombat, player
			set dormant to 2
		endif
	endif
endif


end
$00"

	endif

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScCrea_VentWorm

; Idle = Idle loop
; Idle2 = Closing
; Idle3 = Closed
; Idle4 = Opening
; Death1 = Looted

float timer
short looted
short close

DontSaveObject

if ( MenuMode )
    return
endif

if ( timer > 0 )
    set timer to ( timer - GetSecondsPassed )
    return
endif

; close when player gets too close
if ( close == 1 )
    ; MessageBox ""Player is too close, do [LoopGroup Idle2 0 1]""
     PlaySound ""Kwama forager slither""
    LoopGroup Idle2 0 1
    set timer to 10
    set close to 2
    return
endif

; open when player is far away
if ( GetDistance Player >= 250 )
    if ( close > 0 )
        ; MessageBox ""Far Enough Away, do [LoopGroup Idle4 0 1]""
     PlaySound ""Kwama forager slither""
        LoopGroup Idle4 0 1
        set close to 0
    endif
    if ( close < 0 )
        ; MessageBox ""Finished Opening, do [PlayGroup Idle]""
     PlaySound ""Kwama forager slither""
        PlayGroup Idle
        set close to -1
    endif
    return
endif

if ( close == 0 )
    set close to 1
endif

end$00"

;Create a duplicate of this script, if you want your wereboar to turn into a specific npc

short transformed; whether the creature turned into human
short transformationEffectSpawned
short isNight
short isDead
float time
float xPos
float yPos

	if ( player->GetSpell ""T_Dis_WereboarBlood"" == 1 )

	return

	return

	set isDead to 1

	;change to human
	If ( time >= 1 )

		set yPos to ( getPos, Y )
		set zPos to ( getPos, Z )
		set zRot to ( ( ( getAngle, Z ) + 90 ) * 60 )
		disable
		Placeitem, ""T_Glb_LycWereboar"", xPos, yPos, zPos, zRot 
		set transformed to 1
	endif

		addSpell ""witbane""
	elseif (ran == 1)
		addSpell ""serpiginous dementia""
	elseif (ran == 2)
		addSpell ""Wither""
	elseif (ran == 3)
		addSpell ""Rotbone""

short tP ; pin color used by the AI
short paper1 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 01a
short paper2 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 02a
short paper3 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 03a
short paper4 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 01b
short paper5 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 02b
short paper6 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 03b
short paper7 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 01c
short paper8 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 02c
short paper9 ; Cycle-through variable holding the color occupying pos 03c
short paper11 ; Accumulated value for pos 01a
short paper12 ; Accumulated value for pos 02a
short paper13 ; Accumulated value for pos 03a
short paper14 ; Accumulated value for pos 01b
short paper15 ; Accumulated value for pos 02b
short paper16 ; Accumulated value for pos 03b
short paper17 ; Accumulated value for pos 01c
short paper18 ; Accumulated value for pos 02c
short paper19 ; Accumulated value for pos 03c
short randomvalue
short control ; Holds the accumulated value of the currently analyzed position
short controlvar ; Holds the disadvantage modifier to the position value
short controlB ; Holds the value of a best position found so far
short controlEnd ; Selected best target position for pin move
short controlPicks ; Pin which is to be moved to the selected best target

; If the previous script run has established a pin to move and the best target position, then move it
if ( controlEnd > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin < 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to controlPicks

		if ( controlEnd == 1 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 2 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 3 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 4 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 5 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 6 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 7 )

			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to tP
		elseif ( controlEnd == 9 )
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to tP
		endif

		set tP to 0
		set controlB to -100
		set controlEnd to 0
		set controlPicks to 0

		StartScript ""T_ScGlobal_NineholesMovePin""

		StopScript ""T_ScGlobal_NineholesAiMove""
		return
	endif
endif

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin

;-------------
; One of the scripts originally created for the ""Nine-holes"" mod
; by Dillon241. Ported to Tamriel Data and edited with author's permission.
;-------------

short wager
short messageOn
short button
short WinLose
short tracker

; Delay setting the T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 until after the player clicks Ok
; so that they can see the last move (pins disappear when T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn is 0)
if ( messageOn == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button != -1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 ; so that the pins disappear

		if ( WinLose == 1 ) ; player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 30
			elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 ) ; practice game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
			endif
		else ; player lost
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 40 ; player lost a betting game
			elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 ) ; practice game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
			endif
		endif

		set messageOn to 0
		set button to -1
		set WinLose to 0
		set tracker to 0
		StopScript ""T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin""
	endif
	return
endif

; row 1 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a
		endif
	endif
endif

; row 2 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a
		endif
	endif
endif

; row 3 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a
		endif
	endif
endif

; column A win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a
		endif
	endif
endif

; column B win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b
		endif
	endif
endif

; column C win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( tracker == 1 )
	if ( tracker == T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox ""您作为红方赢得了比赛！挑战结束。与对手对话以进行重赛或结束。"" ""继续""
		else
			MessageBox ""您作为红方赢得了练习赛！"" ""继续""
		endif
		set WinLose to 1
	else
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox ""您的对手（红方）击败了您。您可以再次进行重赛。"" ""继续""
		else
			MessageBox ""您作为白方输掉了练习赛！"" ""继续""
		endif
		set WinLose to 0
	endif
	set messageOn to 1
elseif ( tracker == 2 )
	if ( tracker == T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox ""您作为白方赢得了比赛！挑战结束。与对手对话以进行重赛或结束。"" ""继续""
		else
			MessageBox ""您作为白方赢得了练习赛！"" ""继续""
		endif
		set WinLose to 1
	else
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox ""您的对手（白方）击败了您。您可以再次进行重赛。"" ""继续""
		else
			MessageBox ""您作为红方输掉了练习赛！"" ""继续""
		endif
		set WinLose to 0
	endif
	set messageOn to 1
endif

if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
	if ( WinLose == 1 ) ; player won
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; player wins bet back plus NPC's bet (double the bet)
			set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet * 2 )
			MessageBox ""%G 金币已添加到您的物品栏。"" wager
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				player->AddItem ""Gold_001"" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				player->AddItem ""Gold_001"" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			PlaySound ""Item Gold Up""
		endif
	endif
endif

; MessageBox with buttons was not called so this script can stop
if ( messageOn != 1 )
	StopScript ""T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin""
endif

end$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin T_ScGlobal_NineholesMovePin

;-------------
; One of the scripts originally created for the ""Nine-holes"" mod
; by Dillon241. Ported to Tamriel Data and edited with author's permission.
;-------------

; Accumulated value of pins placed on the board so far. One player
; has value 1, another has 2, so if both have to place 3 pins at most,
; then the value should reach 1+1+1+2+2+2=3+6=9 to reach the 2nd game stage
short whendone

if ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 1 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 2 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 3 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 4 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 5 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 6 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 7 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 8 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 9 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to 0
endif

set whendone to ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
if ( whendone >= 9 ) ; Have both players placed all their initial pins
	set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to -1
else
	set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to 0
endif

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScGlobal_PassTime

;Starting this script emulates the passage of time,
;hour by hour, day by day, month by month, ...
;the amount of hours to pass is first given in
;global short T_Glob_PassTimeHours

short count

if ( count == 0 )
	FadeOut 0.35
	DisablePlayerControls
	set count to 1
endif

If ( count <= T_Glob_PassTimeHours )
	if ( GameHour >= 23 )
		set GameHour to ( GameHour - 23 )
		set DaysPassed to ( DaysPassed + 1 )
		if ( Day == 30 )
			if ( Month == 10 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 8 )
				set Day to 1
				elseif ( Month == 5 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 3 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		elseif ( Day == 31 )
			if ( Month == 11 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 9 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 7 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 6 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 4 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 2 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 0 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		elseif ( Day == 28 )
			if ( Month == 1 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		else
			set Day to ( Day + 1 )
		endif
		if ( Day == 1 )
			if ( Month == 11 )
				set Month to 0
				set Year to ( Year + 1 )
			else
				set Month to ( Month + 1 )
			endif
		endif
	else
		set GameHour to ( GameHour + 1 )
	endif
	set count to ( count + 1 )
	return
Endif

Set T_Glob_PassTimeHours to 0
Set count to 0
FadeIn 0.35
EnablePlayerControls
StopScript ""T_ScGlobal_PassTime""

End$00"
-SCPT

	; delays termination by one frame - not sure if necessary,

	if ( safeguard == 2 )
		StopScript T_ScNews_AbMonitor_Add

	endif

if ( number > 0 )

	; which tracker are we updating?
	set numbersimple to number
	set trackernumber to 0
	while ( numbersimple > 24 )
		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )
		set trackernumber to ( trackernumber + 1 )
	endwhile
	if ( trackernumber < 1 )
		set tracker to T_Glob_News_AbMonitor_Tracker1
	elseif ( trackernumber < 2 )
		set tracker to T_Glob_News_AbMonitor_Tracker2
	else
		; there's no higher tracker, so kill the script.
		StopScript T_ScNews_AbMonitor_Add
	endif

	if ( tracker >= 8388608 )

short numbersimple
short trackernumber

short safeguard

if ( CellChanged == 1 )
	; delays termination by one frame - not sure if necessary,
	; but just to be safe, it's here.
	if ( safeguard == 2 )
		StopScript T_ScNews_Bellman_Add
	else
		set safeguard to ( safeguard + 1 )
	endif
endif

if ( number > 0 )

	; which tracker are we updating?
	set numbersimple to number
	set trackernumber to 0
	while ( numbersimple > 24 )
		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )
		set trackernumber to ( trackernumber + 1 )
	endwhile
	if ( trackernumber < 1 )
		set tracker to T_Glob_News_Bellman_Tracker1
	elseif ( trackernumber < 2 )
		set tracker to T_Glob_News_Bellman_Tracker2
	else
		; there's no higher tracker, so kill the script.
		StopScript T_ScNews_Bellman_Add
	endif

	if ( tracker >= 8388608 )
		set tracker to ( tracker - 8388608 )
	elseif ( numbersimple == 24 )
		set trackerincrease to 8388608 
	endif

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNews_Bellman_Paper

short OnPCAdd
short doOnce
short resetDay

; README
; this rather opaque script ensures that the game treats papers that were placed by hand in the CS different
; from papers that were spawned by script from the T_News_Bellman_Spawner_X objects. The way that
; this is achieved is by using CellChanged - papers placed by hand encounter a CellChanged the first time
; they are loaded, while papers spawned by the Spawner first appear in the game world *after* CellChanged
; has been detected, and passed, on the Spawner object. This means that a spawned paper progresses
; through doOnce==0, ==1 and ==2, while a placed paper is intercepted on the second frame by CellChanged,
; and has its doOnce variable set to -1.

if ( doOnce == -1 )
    Return
endif

if ( CellChanged )
	if ( doOnce == 2 )
		; papers that are at this stage have successfully passed through the setup once, 
		; without being interrupted by CellChanged. This means that they were spawned
		; rather than hand-placed, and as such they get disabled and deleted after two days.
		if ( resetDay <= DaysPassed )
			Disable
			set doOnce to 3
		endif
	else
		; papers that did not proceed through the entire setup are papers that were hand-placed, 
		; and here is where CellChanged interrupts the setup and renders them inert.
		set doOnce to -1
	endif
	Return
endif

if ( OnPCAdd == 1 )
	; OnPCAdd renders the script inert, and ensures the paper does not delete itself.
	set doOnce to -1
	Return
endif

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	set doOnce to 1
	; skip a frame to give CellChanged a chance to trigger
elseif ( doOnce == 1 )
	if ( GetPos Z == 0 )
		if ( GetPos Y == 0 )
			if ( GetPos X == 0 )
				; papers without coordinates are in an inventory, and are rendered inert.
				set doOnce to -1
				Return
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( doOnce == 1 )
		; at this stage, CellChanged has had a chance to trigger - and if it didn't,
		; it means that this paper was spawned into the cell after cell change.
		; here, we set the reset parameters that ensure the paper deletes itself
		; if not picked up within two days.
		set resetDay to ( 2 + DaysPassed )
		set doOnce to 2
	endif
elseif ( doOnce == 3 )
	SetDelete 1
	Return
endif

End$00"
-SCPT

	Return

	if ( CellChanged == 1 )

		endif
	else
		Return
	endif

	Return
endif

if ( doOnce >= 30 ) ; paper has been spawned, check if it should respawn
	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		if ( resetDay <= DaysPassed ) ; if two days have passed, reset and respawn.
			set doOnce to 0
		endif
	else
		Return
	endif
endif

if ( doOnce == 0 )	; if we've reset the script, fire it up.
	set doOnce to 10
	; disable the spawner
	if ( GetDisabled == 0 )
		Disable
	endif
endif

if ( doOnce == 30 )
	Return
elseif ( doOnce == 10 )
	; only if no other script has initialized the randompicker scripts do we proceed
	if ( ScriptRunning T_ScNews_Bellman_Picker1 == 0 )
		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScNews_Bellman_Picker2 == 0 )
			set doOnce to 20
			StartScript T_ScNews_Bellman_Picker1
			StartScript T_ScNews_Bellman_Picker2
		endif
;	else
;		MessageBox ""script already running""
	endif
elseif ( doOnce == 20 )
	; fetch the data on which paper was picked
	if ( T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick1 > 0 )
		set pick1 to T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick1
		set weight1 to ( pick1 / 100 )
		set pick1 to ( pick1 - 100*weight1 )
		set T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick1 to 0
	elseif ( T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick1 < 0 )
		set pick1 to 0
		set weight1 to 0
		set T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick1 to 0
	else
		Return
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick2 > 0 )
		set pick2 to T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick2
		set weight2 to ( pick2 / 100 )
		set pick2 to ( pick2 - 100*weight2 )
		set T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick2 to 0
	elseif ( T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick2 < 0 )
		set pick2 to 0
		set weight2 to 0
		set T_Glob_News_Bellman_Pick2 to 0
	else
		Return
	endif

	set weight2 to ( weight1 + weight2 )
;	set weight3 to ( weight2 + weight3 ) ;etc if you have more pickers

		set randomPaper to ( Random 32767 )
		set randomPaperDiv to ( randomPaper / weight2 )
		set randomPaper to ( randomPaper - ( randomPaperDiv * weight2 ) ) + 0.1

;			set pick1 to pick1
		else
			set pick1 to pick2
; in case of 3 or more pick variables, the latter pick should be the final one in the else bracket here
		endif

			; 50% chance to do nothing

			set doOnce to 0
		endif

		Return

		endif

	if ( T_Glob_News_Echo_Pick2 > 0 )

		set pick2 to ( pick2 - 100*weight2 )
		set T_Glob_News_Echo_Pick2 to 0
	elseif ( T_Glob_News_Echo_Pick2 < 0 )
		set pick2 to 0
		set weight2 to 0
		set T_Glob_News_Echo_Pick2 to 0
	else
		Return
	endif

	set weight2 to ( weight1 + weight2 )
;	set weight3 to ( weight2 + weight3 ) ;etc if you have more pickers

	if ( weight2 > 0 )	; if there are papers in the pool
		set randomPaper to ( Random 32767 )
		set randomPaperDiv to ( randomPaper / weight2 )
		set randomPaper to ( randomPaper - ( randomPaperDiv * weight2 ) ) + 0.1

		if ( weight1 > randomPaper )
;			set pick1 to pick1
		else
			set pick1 to pick2
; in case of 3 or more pick variables, the latter pick should be the final one in the else bracket here
		endif

		; here's where you spawn the papers.
		set randomSpawn to Random 100
		if ( randomSpawn < 50 )
			; 50% chance to do nothing
		elseif ( pick1 == 48 )
			PlaceAtMe T_News_Echo_48 1 0 1
		elseif ( pick1 == 47 )
			PlaceAtMe T_News_Echo_47 1 0 1
		elseif ( pick1 == 46 )
			PlaceAtMe T_News_Echo_46 1 0 1

		elseif ( pick1 == 39 )

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_AnvilNineholes
; This short script allows dialogue to filtered by kingdom.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem ""Gold_001"" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem ""Gold_001"" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem ""Gold_001"" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem ""Gold_001"" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem ""Gold_001"" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem ""Gold_001"" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 1

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_AnvilVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 1

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

End$00"
-SCPT

;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_ChorrolVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 5

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

End$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_DelodiilVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_KvatchVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 3

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

End$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "
Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_SancreTorVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 9

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

End$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_SarchalVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 4

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

End$00"
-SCPT
